basic_info.description: Welcome to this beautiful 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom home offering 1,778 square feet of comfortable living space in the Outer Parkside district! The upper level offers a spacious and functional layout featuring three generously sized bedrooms, including a large master suite with a brand new private balcony. The living room, complete with a wood-burning fireplace, flows into the dining room and kitchen, all accented by newly refinished hardwood floors. A convenient upstairs laundry room adds ease to everyday living. The lower level offers flexible living options with a separate bedroom, full bathroom, and kitchenette, ideal for guests, extended family, or potential rental income. An expansive garage provides abundant storage and parking. Located just minutes from Ocean Beach and within walking distance to St. Ignatius and other top schools, this home blends comfort, and convenience.
